title: Raketten gevaarlijk speelgoed (Polygoon, Weeknummer 58-12) / Rockets: dangerous toys
license: CC-BY-SA 3.0 NL (Open Beelden / Beeld en Geluid; Polygoon-Profilti producent)
notes: Netherlands, Dutch: Polygoon-Profilti newsreel, Petten military range, 1958, commentary Philip Bloemendal — Haarlem amateurs launch a home-built rocket with the War Ministry's permission: carrying it out, a film camera on the dunes, mixing and pouring the fuel, the launch frame on the beach; the long window is the ignition attempts — electric, magnesium, butane — the smoke, the explosion and the twisted frame left on the sand. Source MPG rendition from openbeelden.nl, uncropped.
